id: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Blessing the Children
title: Blessing the Children

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Blessing the Children 1
segments.he: <small>מנהג ישראל לברך את הילדים בלילי שבת כשבאים מבית הכנסת:</small>
segments.en: <small>It has become a widely accepted custom for parents to bless their children on the eve of Shabbos. The placing of both hands upon the child's head when giving the blessing, symbolizes that the blessing is bestowed with fullness of spirit and heart.</small>

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Blessing the Children 2
segments.he: <small>לבן</small> יְשִׂימְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
segments.en: <small>For a boy:</small> May God make you like Ephraim and Menashe. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Blessing the Children 3
segments.he: <small>לבת</small> יְשִׂימֵךְ אֱלֹהִים כְּשָׂרָה רִבְקָה רָחֵל וְלֵאָה. יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
segments.en: <small>For a girl:</small> May God make you like Sorah, Rivkah, Rochel and Leah. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.
